last_completed_unit.result: Pinned official Cargo source-replacement documentation confirms that source replacement may use local directory or local-registry sources. Local registries are downloaded ahead of time, typically synchronized with Cargo.lock, and contain .crate files plus an index. Directory sources contain unpacked crates and per-crate .cargo-checksum.json metadata and are primarily managed by cargo vendor. Replacement assumes identical source code to the replaced source and may not add crates absent from the original source.
